description: A React component named DetailsViewer that renders detailed views of data objects, supporting features like collapsible sections, raw JSON toggle, formatted fields, and agent-specific interactions.

methods.name: safePretty
methods.description: Returns a JSON string of the payload with fallback to string conversion.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Formats a key into a user-friendly label using formatLabel.

methods.name: isTimestampLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a timestamp field.

methods.name: isTokenLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a token count field.

methods.name: isDurationLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a duration or latency field.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a duration string, handling seconds and milliseconds.

methods.name: isCurrencyKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a key name loosely indicates a currency or cost field.

methods.name: formatValueByKey
methods.description: Formats a value based on its key, applying special formatting for currency, tokens, timestamps, or durations.

methods.name: initialCollapsed
methods.description: Decides if a section should be collapsed based on depth and collapsedDepth.

methods.name: renderPrimitiveVal
methods.description: Renders a primitive value with appropriate styling and formatting.

methods.name: extractAgentIdentity
methods.description: Extracts agent ID and name from an object, supporting various legacy and nested fields.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a data node, handling arrays, objects, and primitives with collapsible sections and agent-specific actions.

methods.name: renderEntries
methods.description: Renders object entries as a labeled grid, prioritizing highlight keys and sorting others alphabetically.
